_doc: Edge-envelope NPU-only baseline aligned with AHASPro.md Table 3 (Mobile NPU + LPDDR5). The fast replay path uses the documented 16 TOPS matrix unit, 8.2 TOPS vector unit, and two compute chips to model the dedicated NPU service path; ONNXim still uses the committed c4_128x128 topology as the executable proxy. The memory subsystem remains one 800 MHz 32 B DDR channel, i.e. 51.2 GB/s, matching Table 3. PIM is disabled so DLM and TLM share the same LPDDR5 proxy.
